# FrontLoop: Full Product Description

> FrontLoop is an autonomous B2B WhatsApp AI lead and business agent for small and medium businesses (SMBs): healthcare clinics, coaching and educational institutes, salons, restaurants and local service providers. It provides an always-on AI front desk over the official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API.

Website: https://frontloop.online
Support: trueattendly@gmail.com
WhatsApp & phone: +91 9400160928
Location: Calicut, Kerala, India

---

## What FrontLoop does

Customers message local businesses on WhatsApp at any hour, often after the front desk has closed. FrontLoop replies on the business's behalf, around the clock:

- **Instant 24/7 replies.** Every inquiry is acknowledged and answered immediately, including nights, weekends and holidays.
- **Answers from the business's own knowledge base.** The AI answers questions about services, doctor or trainer timings, course fees, prices and operating hours using only the information the business has configured. It does not book appointments; it captures the request for staff to confirm.
- **Lead capture.** Customer name, phone number, intent and requirement (for example the service they want) are captured into a structured lead pipeline.
- **Human handoff.** When a customer asks for a person, or the conversation needs personal attention, staff can take over. A one-click "human takeover" control pauses the bot on that conversation so staff can handle it.
- **Bilingual understanding.** The assistant understands conversational English and mixed regional phrasing such as Manglish (English-Malayalam).

---

## Who it is for

- **Clinics and healthcare:** doctor rosters and duty timings, consultation fees, clinic address and patient inquiry capture.
- **Coaching and educational institutes:** batch timings, course fees, syllabus questions and demo class or counselling requests.
- **Salons and spas:** service menus and packages, stylist availability and appointment requests.
- **Local service businesses:** rate cards, service policies and capturing customer location and job details.

---

## Product features

### Knowledge base
Each business manages its own knowledge base from the dashboard: services with prices and durations, weekly operating hours and FAQs. Changes take effect for the AI immediately.

### Anti-hallucination guardrails
Answers are generated only from the business's verified knowledge base. If a question falls outside the configured information, the assistant does not invent prices or policies; it tells the customer politely and leaves the follow-up to the team.

### Lead pipeline (CRM dashboard)
- Every WhatsApp contact becomes a lead with name, phone, intent, requirement and message history.
- Leads move through the stages New, Contacted, Converted and Lost.
- Filter by status, search by phone number and export to CSV.
- Staff can add internal notes to each lead and review the full conversation timeline.

### Web chat and QR front desk
Each business gets a public front-desk link and a printable QR card for reception desks and shop windows. Customers who scan it choose WhatsApp or chat directly in their browser after sharing their name and mobile number. Web chats are answered from the same knowledge base, count against the same monthly AI reply allowance, and appear in the dashboard tagged as Web.

### Human takeover
Each conversation has a bot on/off control. While the bot is paused, FrontLoop stops sending automated replies for that customer, and staff reply from the dashboard within WhatsApp's 24-hour customer service window. Paused chats are grouped under a Needs Human filter.

### Reply quota
Each plan includes a monthly allowance of AI replies. The dashboard shows replies used against the plan quota for the current cycle.

## Pricing

All plans are billed monthly in Indian Rupees (INR).

| Plan | Price per month | AI replies per month |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Starter Plan | ₹1,499 | 1,000 |
| Growth Plan | ₹3,499 | 3,500 |
| Pro Plan | ₹7,999 | 10,000 |

Replies within WhatsApp's standard 24-hour customer service window are included in the subscription.

---

## Platform and compliance

- **Official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API.** FrontLoop integrates only through Meta's official Cloud API (Graph API), not unofficial QR-code or web-scraping tools. The business's phone does not need to stay online.
- **Multi-tenant isolation.** Each business's leads, messages and knowledge base are stored separately and scoped to that business.
- **Inbound-first.** FrontLoop replies to customers who contact the business. It does not send unsolicited bulk messages.

---

## Getting started

1. Create a workspace at https://frontloop.online/auth/register.
2. Add services, prices, operating hours and FAQs to the knowledge base.
3. Connect the business's WhatsApp Business number (contact trueattendly@gmail.com for onboarding help).
4. Review captured leads and conversations in the dashboard, and take over any conversation when needed.
